reviewMethod: Reviewed a labeled seven-image contact sheet of coordinate-centered 2025 USDA NAIP crops for Cincinnati. A tighter Sawyer Point and Yeatman's Cove crop was shifted east and reviewed separately so the riverfront recreation area remains legible. Each selection depicts the named destination; source, acquisition, and public-domain metadata remain in the candidate file.
